title: Portfolio Resource Allocation
short_description: Learn how financial planning systems allocate limited capital across investment opportunities to maximize portfolio value and make efficient resource-allocation decisions.

real_world_context.problem: An investor has limited capital and must choose from several investment opportunities with different capital requirements and expected values. The system needs to determine how available resources can be allocated to maximize portfolio value, support partial investments, maximize diversification, rank opportunities, and construct portfolios under multiple constraints.
real_world_context.why_it_matters: Efficient resource-allocation algorithms help investors make effective use of limited capital while evaluating many possible investment combinations and portfolio constraints.

learning_objectives: Understand how investment opportunities can be represented using capital requirements and expected values.
Apply 0/1 Knapsack to select investments that maximize portfolio value within a capital limit.
Apply Fractional Knapsack when investment opportunities can receive partial capital allocation.
Use Greedy techniques to maximize the number of affordable investment opportunities.
Apply Sorting to rank investment opportunities according to their expected values.
Use Dynamic Programming to construct a portfolio with both capital and investment-count constraints.
Understand how different resource-allocation requirements lead to different algorithmic approaches.
Understand why algorithm efficiency matters when managing a large number of investment opportunities.

real_world_mapping.investor: Person or organization allocating available capital
real_world_mapping.investment_opportunity: Available option requiring capital and providing an expected value
real_world_mapping.capital: Limited financial resource available for allocation
real_world_mapping.investment_cost: Amount of capital required for an investment
real_world_mapping.expected_value: Expected value obtained from selecting an investment
real_world_mapping.capital_allocation: Distribution of available capital among investments
real_world_mapping.portfolio_value: Total expected value of selected investments
real_world_mapping.portfolio_diversification: Selection of multiple investment opportunities within the available capital

completion_message: You have completed the Portfolio Resource Allocation mission. You have learned how 0/1 Knapsack, Fractional Knapsack, Greedy, Sorting, and Dynamic Programming can be applied to capital allocation, portfolio optimization, and investment resource-management problems.
